y-m-05-03.title: Toshe-gine nawa ne idan muka ga gaba kawai?
y-m-05-03.topic: Siffar da aka yi da tubalan gini
y-m-05-03.goal: Fahimci cewa ba za a iya yanke jimillar tubalan gini daga kallon gaba kaɗai ba, sannan ka gano bayanin da zai ba ka damar yanke adadin da kuma adadin da zai yiwu.
y-m-05-03.material: Tubalan gini kubiyoyi ne na katako masu girma iri ɗaya. Akwai wuri 3 a jere daga hagu zuwa dama. A layin gaba, wurin hagu yana da tubala 2 (matakai 2), na tsakiya yana da 1, na dama kuma 1, don haka tubala 4 ne gabaɗaya a layin gaba. Daga gaba suna kama da matakala, gefen hagu ya fi tsayi da mataki ɗaya. Wataƙila akwai layin baya bayan layin gaba, amma layin gaba ya ɓoye shi ba a iya gani. Idan akwai layin baya, kowane wuri ba zai kai tsayin wurin da yake daidai da shi a layin gaba ba (idan ya fi tsayi, za a gan shi daga gaba). Tubalan ba sa shawagi a iska, kuma layuka biyu ne kawai: gaba da baya.

y-m-05-06.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Ba za mu iya sani ba. Ba mu san tsawon tazarorin tafin hannun mutanen biyun ba.
y-m-05-06.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Wannan tunani ya fahimci cewa ba za a iya kwatanta ƙimomin da aka auna da ma'auni mabambanta ba.
y-m-05-06.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Wannan tunani ya juya hukuncin farko bayan ganin sabon bayani, amma yana da wuya a ba da dalilinsa.
y-m-05-06.s.s1.st.2.info: Tazarar tafin hannun Gaeun 9cm ce, ta Narae kuma 13cm ce.
y-m-05-06.s.s1.st.2.ask: Me zai faru idan ka nuna tsawon tebur biyun da cm ka kwatanta su?
y-m-05-06.s.s1.st.2.after: Tebur 가 shi ne 9+9+9+9=36cm, Tebur 나 kuma shi ne 13+13+13=39cm. Ko da tazarori sun yi ƙasa da yawa, idan kowace tazara ta fi tsawo, wannan tebur na iya zama mafi tsawo.
y-m-05-06.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Wannan tunani ya kimanta cewa bambancin tsawon tazarorin ya yi daidai da bambancin yawan tazarori.
y-m-05-06.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Wannan tunani ya ɗauka cewa wanda yake da tazarori da yawa har yanzu ya fi tsawo.
y-m-05-06.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Wannan tunani ya nemo tsawon kowane tebur da cm sannan ya kwatanta su.
y-m-05-06.s.s1.reflect: Idan mutum ɗaya ya auna, za mu iya kwatanta ta yawan tazarorin. Amma idan mutane mabambanta suka auna da tazarorin hannunsu, yana da wuya a tabbatar. Za mu iya kwatantawa ne kawai bayan mun san tsawon tazara guda da ma'auni iri ɗaya (cm).
y-m-05-06.s.s2.prompt: Idan Tebur 가 (tazarori 4) da Tebur 나 (tazarori 3) suna da tsawo iri ɗaya, nemo nau'i-nau'i uku mabambanta na tsawon tazarar tafin hannun Gaeun a cm da tazarar Narae b cm. (Tazarorin tafin hannun mutanen biyun lambobi ne na halitta daga 8cm zuwa 20cm.)
y-m-05-06.s.s2.hint.0: Da farko yanke a, nemo tsawon cm na tazarori 4 na Gaeun, sannan nemo b da zai sa tazarori 3 na Narae su kai tsawo iri ɗaya.
y-m-05-06.s.s2.hint.1: Duba cewa b lambar halitta ce kuma ba ta wuce 20 ba.
y-m-05-06.s.s2.ok.c1: Tazarorin tafin hannun mutanen biyun lambobi ne na halitta daga 8cm zuwa 20cm.
y-m-05-06.s.s2.fail.c1: Tazarar tafin hannu dole ta zama lambar halitta daga 8cm zuwa 20cm.
y-m-05-06.s.s2.ok.c2: Tazarori 4 da tazarori 3 suna da tsawo iri ɗaya.
y-m-05-06.s.s2.fail.c2: Tsawon tebur biyun ba iri ɗaya ba ne. Nemo tsawon cm na tazarori 4 na Gaeun da na tazarori 3 na Narae, sannan ka kwatanta su.
y-m-05-06.s.s2.explain: Idan tazarar Gaeun 9cm ce, ta Narae kuma 12cm ce, duka tsawon 36cm ne, iri ɗaya. 12cm da 16cm (48cm), da kuma 15cm da 20cm (60cm) su ma suna yiwuwa. Daga 8cm zuwa 20cm, waɗannan ukun ne kawai.
y-m-05-06.s.s2.because.prompt: Rubuta dalilin da ya sa tebur biyu za su iya samun tsawo iri ɗaya ko da adadin tazarori mabambanta ne, 4 da 3.
y-m-05-06.s.s2.because.hint.0: Zaɓi nau'i-nau'i guda daga waɗanda ka samu a sama, ka rubuta tazarar Gaeun da ta Narae gefe da gefe.
y-m-05-06.s.s2.because.hint.1: Kwatanta yadda tazarar tafin hannun wanda ya auna sau kaɗan take.
y-m-05-06.s.s2.because.placeholder: Misali: Tazarar tafin hannun Narae ita ce ...
y-m-05-06.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ka faɗi cewa tazarar tafin hannun mutum ɗaya ta fi tsawo?
y-m-05-06.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ka faɗi cewa domin tsawon ya zama iri ɗaya, wanda ya auna sau kaɗan dole ne ya fi tsawon tazarar tafin hannu?
y-m-05-06.s.s2.because.model.0: Tazarar tafin hannun Narae ta fi ta Gaeun tsawo, saboda haka ko da an auna sau 3 kawai za a iya samun tsawo iri ɗaya da Gaeun ta auna sau 4.
y-m-05-06.s.s2.because.model.1: Idan tazarar Gaeun 9cm ce, ta Narae kuma 12cm ce, haɗa 9 sau huɗu da 12 sau uku duk yana ba da 36cm, iri ɗaya. Idan tazarar ta fi girma, aunawa kaɗan na iya ba da tsawo iri ɗaya.
y-m-05-06.s.s2.because.model.2: Tsawon tazarorin ya bambanta daga mutum zuwa mutum, don haka idan tazarar Narae ta fi tsawo, ana buƙatar tazarori kaɗan domin kai tsawo iri ɗaya.

y-m-05-07.title: Ta yaya za mu ƙirga alwatika a cikin murabba'i ba tare da barin ko ɗaya ba?
y-m-05-07.goal: Kwatanta hanyoyin ƙirga alwatika manya da ƙanana a hoto ba tare da barin ko ɗaya ko ƙirga guda sau biyu ba; gyara ƙirga mara kyau, sannan ka ƙirƙiri hanyar ƙirgawa da kanka ga wani hoto dabam.
y-m-05-07.material: Daga kusurwar sama ta hagu, kana tafiya a agogo, kira kusurwoyin takardar murabba'i ㄱ, ㄴ, ㄷ, da ㄹ. Haɗa ㄱ da ㄷ da ㄴ da ㄹ da layuka madaidaiciya, layukan biyun kuma suna haɗuwa a tsakiyar batu ㅁ. Muna son ƙirga duk alwatika manya da ƙanana da ake iya samu a wannan hoton. Dole ne gefuna ukun kowace alwatika su kasance a kan layukan da aka zana a hoton. (Ana karanta ㄱ da giyeok, ㄴ da nieun, ㄷ da digeut, ㄹ da rieul, ㅁ kuma da mieum.)
y-m-05-07.thinking.1: Nemo layin da bai dace ba a cikin ƙirga
y-m-05-07.thinking.2: Amfani da hanyar ƙirgawa ga sabon hoto
y-m-05-07.prereq.0: Sanin cewa alwatika siffa ce da layuka madaidaiciya 3 suka kewaye (matakin aji na 2)
y-m-05-07.prereq.1: Ƙirga da haɗa lambobi kusa da 10
y-m-05-07.s.s1.prompt: Abokai huɗu sun bayyana yadda suke ƙirga alwatika. Zaɓi duk hanyoyin da za su iya ƙirga kowace alwatika ba tare da barin ko ɗaya ko ƙirga wata sau biyu ba.
y-m-05-07.s.s1.hint.0: Ga kowace hanya, yi tunanin alwatikan da za a iya bari ba a ƙirga ba.
y-m-05-07.s.s1.hint.1: Duba ko za a iya bambance alwatikan da aka ƙirga ta kowace hanya ba tare da sun yi taɓa juna ba.
y-m-05-07.s.s1.r.a: Wannan tunani bai ƙirga manyan alwatikan da aka yi ta haɗa ƙananan alwatika biyu ba.
y-m-05-07.s.s1.o.b: Daon: Da farko ƙirga ƙananan, sannan ka ƙirga waɗanda aka yi ta haɗa ƙananan biyu.
y-m-05-07.s.s1.r.b: Wannan tunani ya tsara su bisa girma, sannan ya ƙirga a jere.
y-m-05-07.s.s1.o.c: Hajun: Zaɓi batu 3 daga cikin batutuwa 5 a kowane lokaci, amma ka cire batutuwa uku da suke kan layi madaidaiciya.
y-m-05-07.s.s1.r.c: Wannan tunani yana ƙirga ba tare da barin ko ɗaya ba ta hanyar zaɓar batutuwa, sannan ya cire yanayin da ba ya samar da alwatika.
y-m-05-07.s.s1.o.d: Yuna: Ƙirga duk abin da ya ja hankali.
y-m-05-07.s.s1.r.d: Wannan tunani ba shi da tsari ko ƙa'ida, don haka ƙila ya bar wasu ko ya ƙirga wasu sau biyu.
y-m-05-07.s.s1.explain: Ƙirga a jere bisa girma, da kuma zaɓar batu 3 a lokaci guda tare da cire batutuwa uku da ke kan layi madaidaiciya, duka suna iya ƙirga kowace alwatika. Ƙirga ƙanana kawai ko ƙirga abin da ya ja hankali na iya barin wasu.
y-m-05-07.s.s1.acc.0: Hanyar Daon za ta iya ƙirga dukansu. Hanyar Hajun ma za ta iya ƙirga dukansu.
